label: exploratory (REANALYSIS_RULE.md Section 6; unadjusted; never used for a headline claim)
notes: reporting only (rule 4.5 continuity); the primary results are reproduced, never changed

definitions.square_Delta20: r(alt20) - r(mis20) on the 30 square configurations
definitions.P5: E(0) = I - C; E_rig = RI - RC; E'_mis = M - MC; L_uni = E(0) - E'_mis; L_rig = E(0) - E_rig; A* = E_rig - E'_mis; C* = L_uni - 2 L_rig; s* = L_rig / L_uni (theta = 20)
definitions.measure: r_inside (rule 2.2); readouts seed-averaged per configuration, then the 336 and 448 px values

method.resample: two-stage: clusters with replacement, then positions with replacement within each drawn cluster slot; 10,000 resamples; numpy RandomState(2026), cluster draws first (analyze_re.two_stage_idx)
method.linear: analyze_re.pct_summary: published two-stage percentile interval and bootstrap p, 10,000 resamples
method.ratio: analyze_re.pct_ratio: published two-stage percentile interval of the ratio of resampled means
method.ratio_difference: pct_ratio_diff: percentile interval of the resample-wise difference of the two ratios of resampled means under the same published indices (a composition; choice (e))
method.p: two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2 min(share of resampled means <= 0, share >= 0)) for linear quantities; none for ratio-type quantities
method.reportability: rule 4.3 (stored WCU checks of the denominators) decides what the markdown prints
